progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on D in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:25.4) introduces A, B, C, D, centred on A. Phrase 7 (2:19.0) introduces Ek, centred on F. The line peaks at Ek5 (605.7 Hz) at 2:52.0. It closes on the tonic (G4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → G4 → G4 → D4).
